tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Find local service businesses that take AI bookings with a deposit, by trade (plumbing, hvac, appliance repair, cleaning, electrical, pest control...) and 5-digit zip. Returns business_id values for the other tools.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Details for one business from search_businesses: name, services, hours, deposit and the refund policy.

tools.name: get_open_times
tools.description: Open appointment times for a business over the next days (default 7, max 14). Pass a start value to book_with_deposit.

tools.name: book_with_deposit
tools.description: Hold a time for the homeowner and get a card payment link for the deposit. Ask the homeowner for their name, phone, service address and a short description of the problem first. The time is held for 20 minutes and is booked only when they pay. Tell them: The deposit comes off your final bill. Refund
